result.brief: 提出 DOVE：在约 53 万张无标注口腔照片上做领域自适应自监督预训练，得到可迁移、标签高效的视觉表征骨干，并在分类与分割任务上验证少样本迁移优势。
result.reason: Domain-adaptive self-supervised pretraining (DINOv3-style) on 530k unlabeled oral photographs yields transferable visual representations, directly matching visual representation learning interests.
